title: review-report.json (code-review pipeline RV1-RV8 + RV7b output; local .agents/state/ or CI artifact)

signals.description: collected by RV1 for later stages

public_api_change.description: skipped when the agentive manifest has no paths.public_api

inline_suppressions.description: added suppression lines (advisory checklist for RV5)

new_direct_dependencies.description: the added dependency names of package files (<ecosystem>:<name>; go indirect requires left out); advisory (DEPHUMAN: the tier comes from dependency_changes)

dependency_changes.description: DEPHUMAN (E2E-20, user 2026-10-31): the dependency data this diff changes. Only the dependency entries of package files count (never the tool configuration that shares the file, such as pyproject.toml [tool.ruff] or package.json scripts); any non-empty list except package_files makes RV2 add dependency_change (tier 2)

added.description: dependency keys in head and not in base: <ecosystem>:<name>, or <ecosystem>-<kind>:<name> for an entry that changes where or which version is resolved (npm-override, pypi-option, pypi-url, go-replace, cargo-patch, maven-parent, maven-plugin, maven-properties, gradle-plugin)

removed.description: dependency keys in base and not in head

changed.description: keys in both whose spec (group and version text) differs

lockfiles.description: lockfiles whose content changed (added, deleted or modified; a pure rename is no change)

unreadable.description: package files that changed but could not be read (fail closed: counted as a dependency change)

package_files.description: package files whose dependency entries changed or that could not be read: RV3 class deps; another changed package file is class config

production_modules_touched.description: rubric@2 (E2E-13): the modules of the changed production files (tests, docs, lock, generated and vendor files left out)

production_shared_path_touched.description: rubric@2 (E2E-13): a changed production file matches the rubric shared_globs

incident_history_90d.description: revert or hotfix on a touched file within 90 days

recent_churn_30d.description: a touched file changed within 30 days

production_churn_commits_90d.description: rubric@2 (E2E-13, revised 2026-10-31): the most changes landed on the base branch within 90 days on one changed production file: records of the base's first-parent history, merge commits included (a merged PR, a squash commit or a direct commit counts 1; a rebase-merged PR counts one per commit)

chain.description: artifact-chain order check (decisions.accepted CHAIN; rules in pr-body-agentive-review.schema.json x-agentive-chain). Computed by RV1 from the diff, the base tree and agentive-review.chain; RV8 blocks on chain_order (profile ci); the precommit profile reports only

layer.description: SECPATHS layer: org = declared by the organization or the project (CODEOWNERS snapshot, add), default = the shipped floor, content = a content rule or stack preset, protected = the built-in protected_check_config

source.description: codeowners:<line>, preset:<id> or add, when the entry has one

contains.description: content rule: the text found in an added or removed line

confirm_scope_hits.description: RV2.confirm_scope: changed paths that match agentive-review-rules.trust_boundary.confirm_scope_globs (U2 confirm_scope categories)

shadow_hits.description: hits of shadow rules (report only, no tier effect): the would-have-hit list a human reads before promoting a learned rule

layer.description: SECPATHS layer: org = declared by the organization or the project (CODEOWNERS snapshot, add), default = the shipped floor, content = a content rule or stack preset, protected = the built-in protected_check_config

source.description: codeowners:<line>, preset:<id> or add, when the entry has one

contains.description: content rule: the text found in an added or removed line

removed.description: the project's remove entries in force, each with its reason (SECPATHS)

security_checks.description: security tools configured in the repo (agentive manifest security_checks) against this run's check results; fail -> always_human, not_run is recorded only (SECPATHS L1)

llm_valid.description: false -> the LLM layer output was invalid and the PR goes to a human

raised_by_llm.description: RV4.raise: the raise-only check moved the tier to 2 (reason llm_raise)

raised_by.description: present when the RV4 raise-only check moved the tier to 2 (SECPATHS L4): a human can promote the raise into a path or content rule

raised.description: what the LLM raise was about: the paths it named (optional), its one-sentence reason, the criteria

session_id.description: the platform session id when known: a hook input session_id (local) or the CI action's session_id output; absent when nobody reported one

agent_id.description: agent_id of the observed subagent (SubagentStart or SubagentStop hook input)

agent_type.description: agent_type of the observed subagent (hook input), the reviewer id

reviewed_ref.description: what was reviewed: the staged tree hash (precommit) or the head sha

task_ref.description: correlation id of the review task (written by the script; not a platform session id)

findings.description: RV6 output (merged, deduped, ranked); RV7 fills verification

rv7b.description: RV7b risk score (U6 agentive:rubric@1); computed only, never compared with the threshold here

reason_codes.description: the same decision as reason codes (optional; $defs.gate_reason); every code the gate rules name

auto_merge_setting.description: review.auto_merge read at gate time from the base commit (DEFAULTS, 2026-10-29): the framework default low_risk unless .agents/framework.yaml overrides it; an unknown value reads as off

check_conclusion.description: never neutral. block -> failure; human_required -> success with auto_merge false (the directing human merges, P3); pass -> success

auto_merge.description: true -> gate runs gh pr merge --auto

demoted.description: U1.c: a demotion issue is open for this PR's tier and source

would_auto_merge.description: every condition for auto-merge held but review.auto_merge does not merge this tier: the gate labels the PR agentive:shadow-auto-merge and a human merges

count.description: auto-merged PRs of this tier and source reverted or hotfixed within 7 days, counted after the latest close of a demotion issue for this scope

gate_only.description: conditions that block auto-merge without raising the tier

required_checks.description: E2E-19 (decisions.accepted[EFFECTIVECHECKS], 2026-10-31): the required checks in force, computed at gate time and written nowhere: require_checks minus the pending verbs of the default list (not_required: an info line, never blocking); a list the user wrote in .agents/framework.yaml keeps every verb (a pending one is reason pending_verbs); no required verb with a command is reason no_required_check

display.description: E2E-34 (decision e2e_32_36, 2026-11-01): written only on a first install (the base commit has no agentive manifest): the same lists computed with the pending verbs of the PR's own agentive manifest, for the summary comment and the gate summary only; the decision, the floor and pending_verbs use the base (display only)

source.const: this PR's agentive manifest (first install: the base has none)

head_sha.description: the decision is bound to this head (P4)

explainer.description: tier-2 ## Explainer presence check (decisions.accepted EXPLAIN, revised 2026-10-27: presence only; rules in pr-body-agentive-review.schema.json x-agentive-body-headings.tier2_explainer). Mermaid syntax and code refs are not checked; retired fields: head_refs, unresolved_refs; retired problem code: no_head_code_ref

required.description: true exactly when RV4 assigned tier 2, except a tier 2 whose only cause is the RV4 raise-only check giving no usable answer (reasons contain llm_output_invalid): the Explainer is then not required (E2E-43)

next_action.description: message shown in the check summary, e.g. run /pr --explain

trigger.description: event that ran this gate decision; edited, labeled (an allowlisted label, LABELTRIGGER) and pull_request_review_comment (an agentive-reply line) re-run the gate without a new review round. pull_request_review is not a trigger (retired 2026-10-27, F-08: the gate does not run on a review submission)

present.description: the presence check, one boolean per rule: ## Explainer exists, is the first level-2 heading, has ### Before and ### After (in this order), and each holds a ```mermaid block

allOf.description: explainer_missing blocks: decision block (check failure) with reason explainer_missing

u2.description: U2 final confirmation record (decision U2=B and U2.non_interactive, user 2026-10-14). human_confirmation obtained only when a human answered the confirmation in the run that made the change; a missing record counts as not_obtained.

run.description: unknown: CI cannot tell how the change was made (no official signal separates claude -p in a hook, UV-12); treated like non_interactive unless a human confirmation is recorded

action.description: pr_only_tier2: no direct commit to the default branch and no merge; PR only, tier 2

round.description: 1 = first review of the PR; +1 per new reviewed head

mode.description: round 1 and an explicit agentive:full-review request are full; later rounds review only the diff since the last reviewed head plus open findings

method.description: execution (a reproducing test or shell command) first, otherwise a different-model verifier

reviewers.description: kept after dedupe so one axis does not mask another

trigger.description: the condition under which the defect shows (required with file:line)

bug_class.description: closed enum (FINDINGID, 2026-10-29): the reviewer free text goes to pattern; part of the finding id at the first sighting

shadow.description: from a shadow reviewer: never blocking

source.description: reply_line = an agentive-reply line from an author with write access; next_round = the finding did not recur in the next round (the only way fixed is confirmed); inferred = a reason inferred at read time from a plain reply, tagged [inferred]

comment_id.description: REST id of the reply comment that holds the agentive-reply line

pattern.description: the reviewer's free-text name for the bug class (display only, not part of the id)

anchor_key.description: script-computed: <sha256[:16] of the anchor line, whitespace removed, first 100 characters>:<n earlier lines of the file with the same hash>, or line:<n> when the file was not readable; stored in the comment marker and never recomputed

anchor_excerpt.description: the anchor line as it was at the first sighting, verbatim (shown to the reviewer in later rounds)

reviewer_line.description: E2E-39: the line the reviewer named when it was past the end of the file; line then holds the placed line (nearest changed line, or 1 with file_level true)

line_note.description: E2E-39: one sentence saying the reviewer's line was outside the file and what the script did; shown in the inline comment

file_level.description: E2E-39: true when the diff adds no line to point at, so the finding is posted as a file-level comment (line is 1)

matched_by.description: this report is the same finding as a posted one: M1 same_as (reviewer), M2 equal anchor_key, M3 the anchor line moved by at most 3 lines (design judgment); the posted id is kept

unconfirmed.description: a posted finding that no report matches and whose fix could not be confirmed (no reviewer output, same head, or the anchor line is still there): stays open, never counted as fixed

reopened.description: the author replied fixed and a reviewer reports the finding again: same id, open again

fixed_evidence.description: the evidence a reviewer gave when it reported a posted finding fixed

allOf.description: only important findings can block (F1f)
shadow reviewer findings never block

gate_reason.description: machine-readable reason codes of the RV8 decision (F-24, 2026-10-27): failing_required_check and unanswered_finding (block), U2.non_interactive (human_required, RV4.u2_non_interactive), explainer_missing and chain_order (block), tier2, trust_boundary (RV2 hit), always_human, chain_approval, llm_raise (RV4 raise-only check), critical_cve_unchecked (retired by DEPHUMAN, 2026-10-31: no longer written; kept so earlier reports validate), dependency_change (DEPHUMAN, E2E-20: the PR changes a dependency list or a lockfile; tier 2, human_required, with the one-line cause), inconclusive_finding, finding_disputed, review_rounds_exceeded, pending_verbs (human_required: a required check the user named in require_checks has no command, so auto-merge is unavailable until the command is given or the check is removed from require_checks, PENDINGNOTICE as revised by EFFECTIVECHECKS), no_required_check (E2E-19 floor: no required check has a command, so nothing was verified: human_required), would_auto_merge (review.auto_merge did not merge a PR that met every condition: label agentive:would-auto-merge), tier1_off, rubric_invalid, score_above_threshold, demoted (tier 1 or the kill switch keeps auto-merge off), gate_only (a gate-only condition), coverage_unavailable (the coverage gate was skipped), auto_merge_off (review.auto_merge is off). reasons[] stays free text for people; bot_pr_exempt and human_pr_exempt (V2-08, 2026-10-29): the PR is exempt from agentive-independence (a bot PR, or a human PR without an agentive-review block), is never auto-merged and goes to a human; ai_review_skipped (E2E-11, 2026-10-30): the Claude Code action skipped the AI review because the run's .github/workflows/agentive-review.yml differs from the default branch's copy (first install, workflow change, a base that differs from the default branch, an old merge commit) or the PR comes from a fork: human_required, never auto-merged; ai_step_failed (E2E-10b, 2026-10-30): the ai-review LLM step failed; the reason line carries only an allowlisted code (insufficient_credits, auth, rate_limit, timeout, context_too_long, max_turns, no_result, unclassified, codex_exit), a fixed sentence and the run URL, never the error text

allOf.description: tier 2 never auto-merges
review.auto_merge off or dry_run: nothing auto-merges
review.auto_merge low_risk: tier 1 never auto-merges
tier 1 auto-merge (review.auto_merge low_and_medium_risk) needs a computed RV7b score and no demotion (score <= human_if_score_gt is checked by RV8; JSON Schema cannot compare two fields)
no confirm_scope hit -> nothing to confirm
confirm_scope hit -> human_confirmation is obtained or not_obtained
U2.non_interactive: confirm_scope hit without human confirmation -> PR only, tier 2 (reason U2.non_interactive)
action commit when a human confirmed or nothing needs confirming
a non-interactive or unknown run cannot hold a human confirmation
PR body without agentive-review.u2 -> unknown run, no confirmation
U2.non_interactive: PR only, tier 2 -> the gate never auto-merges and asks a human (or blocks)
tier 0 or 1 auto-merge records the kill-switch scope it was checked against
profile ci: every posted finding is verified by RV7 (2026-10-27) and every blocking finding is confirmed
profile ci requires rv3 and rv4
profile precommit runs RV1, RV2, RV5 only

tier 2 in profile ci: RV8 records the ## Explainer check (required, ok or explainer_missing); not when the tier is 2 only because the RV4 raise-only check gave no usable answer (reason llm_output_invalid, E2E-43)

tier 2 only because the AI step of the RV4 raise-only check failed or answered unusably (reason llm_output_invalid; the rules said tier 0 or 1): a human decides (human_required) and the author cannot fix a CI failure with an Explainer, so ## Explainer is not required (E2E-43, decisions.accepted EXPLAIN / AISTEPFAIL)
tier 0 and tier 1: ## Explainer is not required (F3 unchanged)
CHAIN: an intent or spec PR is always tier 2 with reason chain_approval (RV2 always_human; its merge is the human approval)
CHAIN: a chain order problem blocks: RV8 decision block (check failure) with reason chain_order

REPLYLINE: a confirmed important finding answered with wrong, intentional or not_important instead of a fix -> no auto-merge, human_required (or block) with reason finding_disputed, whoever wrote the reply

description: In profile ci every posted finding carries an RV7 verification and every blocking finding is confirmed important (refuted/inconclusive, nit and pre_existing findings never block). In profile precommit (RV1, RV2, RV5) RV3, RV4, RV7b, RV7, RV6 and RV8 do not run; rv3 and rv4 are absent. In profile ci RV7b and RV8 output are required; tier 2 never auto-merges; tier 1 auto-merge requires a computed RV7b score, tier1 mode on and no demotion; human_required concludes success with auto-merge off.
